jobs.name: text-confirm
jobs._what: a text in from a number whose approved text was handed to the phone but never acked proves it went out: mark it sent + close its 'text unconfirmed' card (mc_server does this on every inbound; this is the safety net)

jobs.name: comms-state
jobs._what: the comms substrate (thread states + SLAs + breach tickets); the 1-min probe task rebuilds it too, this is the safety net

jobs.name: form-ingest
jobs._what: the owner's standing rule 2026-10-29 ('it needs to be a standard operation whenever a form comes filled in'): every completed CRM intake form in the snapshot (the connector carries its answers) is filed once onto the client's page (config wiki.client_pages) and into the delivery ledger entry (data/form_fields.json map, then the generic location / start time / headcount / day-of contact / coordinator); zero-LLM, idempotent, linted, committed scoped

jobs.name: cards-sweep
jobs._what: expire dead cards, harvest the owner's answers (free text / edits -> tickets + learnings)

jobs.name: reflex
jobs._what: the reflex (assistant/agent/reflex.py, 2026-10-27): reads the stores this system already writes for faults (a spine job failing in a row, questions held on a usage limit with an account idle, a doer job staged on a limit, a built-but-unlanded build, a build request nobody picked up, a switched-off line that still posted), fixes each by code one step a pass, verifies within the hour, escalates once; binds owner rules to the code that posts lines

jobs.name: projects
jobs._what: long-running problems (assistant/agent/projects.py, 2026-10-27): every project whose next step is due is run through the existing hands (a doer job, an operator card, a build request, one line to the owner, a decision card, a wait); outcomes are read back from the tickets, the builder and the cards; a failed step moves to the next untried approach, never the same one; out of ways -> one line to the owners, once. Zero-LLM; the bridge's minute tick runs the planning turns

jobs.name: outcomes-settle
jobs._what: the outcome ledger (outcomes.py, 2026-10-24): re-run the verifier of every claim that is due (a text waits for its reply/ack, a doer job for its evidence), ask the owner ONCE about one that cannot be confirmed, close what is proven; the card marks and ticket closes read from it

jobs.name: cards-digest
jobs._what: the weekly approvals digest (the owner 2026-10-20): once the slot (config cards.digest_day/hour) has passed, ONE drop-down Chat message with every held card; nothing between digests except urgent cards

jobs.name: drain
jobs._what: run approved exec tickets through registered scripts (email_send etc.); quiet hours enforced inside

jobs.name: sheet-fix
jobs._what: the pending edits to the pricing sheet (pricing/sheet_edits.json) as ONE card, before-values read live over the Sheets API (agent/google_api.py, account the owner-films): waits for the owner's one-time Sheets consent, posts nothing while a card is open or a sheet_set ticket is queued, and stops for good once the sheet holds every edit (data/sheet_fix_state.json) or the owner tapped Skip. Zero-LLM, never writes a cell itself (drain does, after the tap). Added 2026-10-18 after the doer could not drive the Sheets UI.

jobs.name: doer-tick
jobs._what: the doer (assistant/doer): if an agent_run ticket is waiting (Sage's `do`), run ONE browser task in a headless model turn (sonnet) on the shared signed-in profile; irreversible steps stop at a checkpoint card. Sage wakes this at once when it queues a task; the spine is the backstop. Zero tokens when nothing waits

jobs.name: learn-tick
jobs._what: the doer's self-learning engine (assistant/doer/learn.py, zero-LLM): harvest the turns' lesson.json into skills, score tools, turn repeated hand-done jobs into 'build a tool' tickets and failed tools into 'repair' tickets. Self-paced: it decides inside whether a tick is due (10 min when hot, 6 h when idle) and how many jobs a day it may queue

jobs.name: learn-digest
jobs._what: one plain line to the owner's chat with Sage in the evening when the engine learned something today (skills kept, tools touched, repairs waiting); silent otherwise

jobs.name: doer-warm
jobs._what: sign the doer's browser in to every site whose playbook says warm=true (assistant/data/doer/sites.json), off-screen, so sessions never go cold; captchas / codes / failures land in sites_status.json (connection doer-sessions). Zero LLM

jobs.name: mc-keepalive
jobs._what: start the Mission Control server if :9019 is not answering (the launcher exits at once when it is)

jobs.name: followups-tick
jobs._what: fire due follow-ups into the queue (also runs inside the operator tick; here it is the backstop)

jobs.name: conn-check
jobs._what: prove every connection in assistant/connections.json alive (IMAP login, iCal fetch, sensor status files, CLIs, MCP registration) -> data/connections_status.json; sentinels turn a dead one into a finding (runs before sentinels)

jobs.name: sentinels
jobs._what: stuck-work watchdog -> one latched digest ticket

jobs.name: heartbeat
jobs._what: cron liveness (dreaming, graphify, ...) -> alert once, deduped

jobs.name: gate-health
jobs._what: send-gate tripwire re-proved mechanically

jobs.name: graphify
jobs._what: wikilink-graph staleness watch + rebuild

jobs.name: log-rotate
jobs._what: rotate oversized cron logs

jobs.name: rescue-kit
jobs._what: mirror the repo + runtime state to I:\VAULT_RESCUE and L:\VAULT_RESCUE (local only; GitHub mirror is the owner's call)

jobs.name: agent-bridge
jobs._what: keep the conversational agent's loop alive (assistant/agent: chat channels -> read-only brain -> SUGGEST writers -> reply; also fires the agent's own schedules every minute). Starts it detached if it is not running; exits at once when it is

jobs.name: agent-dream
jobs._what: the agent's nightly learning pass over its own conversations (one read-only opus turn; validated, capped, evidence-cited changes to rules / memory / wiki notes / schedules), hands the transcript to Memory/Daily_Logs for the 06:30 dreaming, posts the daily digest with undo ids, commits assistant/agent/state

jobs.name: agent-dream-day
jobs._what: daytime learning passes while the agent is new (the owner 2026-10-05): the same review as the nightly dream over what is new since the last one, so lessons become rules / memory / wiki notes / schedules within hours. Skips with fewer than 6 new lines from people; posts only what it changed, with undo ids. Set enabled:false to go back to nightly only

jobs.name: agent-builder
jobs._what: Sage's builder (the owner 2026-10-07: 'full hands off'): when a wiki build note or a 'needs a code change' dream-ask is open, starts ONE detached builder run (git worktree, headless opus with edit tools + tests only; verify protected paths, tests vs baseline, gate check; commit; fast-forward master; Chat note with git revert ids). kick returns at once; max 4 runs a day, 60 min apart

jobs.name: agent-pending
jobs._what: The owners' approval queue (Memory/skill-suggestions.md ## Pending, the owner 2026-10-18): folds repeats, closes the builder's dropped requests, ages out asks unanswered for 7 days, and puts each remaining entry in Google Chat as a card with action buttons (max 3 open at once; the tap is done by code in cards.sweep). Zero-LLM

jobs.name: dashboard-rebuild
jobs._what: refresh the static mission-control page (the server rebuilds on request too)

jobs.name: tracking-chase
jobs._what: Sage's per-lane chaser (example's shape, ruling 1 2026-10-15): one nudge card per lane per day about what waits on the owner (stale open cards, staged tickets, fired follow-ups), re-asked after a day, parked after 3; posted in the owner's measured active hours (rhythm.py); taps harvested every run

jobs.name: tracking-weekly
jobs._what: the Friday readback to the shared space + ONE weekly record-check card whose approve mints a tracking_fix ticket (internal writes only); gated inside to tracking.json -> weekly.readback_day/readback_after, once per week

jobs.name: tracking-scheduling
jobs._what: meeting scheduling (ruling 12): reads replies to the call-times cards; a picked slot -> the confirmation message card + a calendar_hold card; unanswered offers expire after tracking.json -> scheduling.proposal_ttl_days. Proposals themselves are made by the operator / Sage (scheduling.py propose)

jobs.name: tracking-probation
jobs._what: the 20-right-in-a-row tally (ruling 9) per class from the card answers + exec ledger; at the bar ONE 'Make it automatic?' card. The code never flips a gate (README 'Probation')

jobs.name: money-pull
jobs._what: READ-ONLY bank feed: SimpleFIN GET /accounts (the protocol's only data call) -> data/money/ledger.json, incremental; ~4 pulls a day of SimpleFIN's 24 (feed.max_pulls_per_day caps it). NOT_CONFIGURED until the owner stores the token from /setup

jobs.name: money-pull-plaid
jobs._what: READ-ONLY bank feed for Relay: Plaid /transactions/sync (cursor) + /accounts/balance/get -> the same data/money/ledger.json; ~4 pulls a day (feeds[plaid].max_pulls_per_day caps it). NOT_CONFIGURED / NOT_LINKED until the owner enters the keys and links Relay from /setup

jobs.name: money-categorize
jobs._what: money_rules.json over the ledger (business Schedule C buckets vs personal, Relay buckets by name, own-account transfers paired); harvests the owner's typed answers on the weekly unknowns card into learned rules; posts that ONE card on money.json -> categorize.unknowns_day

jobs.name: money-forecast
jobs._what: recurring charges -> upcoming bills armed as followups money/bill-due (T-3d reminder; no new reminder path); ONE latched card when a week's bills exceed the paying account's balance or a subscription price jumps. Never pays

jobs.name: money-monthly
jobs._what: the 1st-of-month money readback (income, spend by bucket, business profit vs last month, balances, where the next quarterly stands) to the owners' shared space via agent/bridge.post; gated inside to money.json -> monthly.day/after, once per month

jobs.name: tracking-entities
jobs._what: the world model (ruling 11): one row per lead / couple / edit / money obligation / person / trip / appointment with stage, next action, deadline, days overdue, scored by the priority brain (ruling 10: dollars + who waits + hard dates x urgency, Eisenhower quadrant) -> data/tracking/entities.json for the Friday Q2 nudges and the day plan. Zero LLM, read-only

jobs.name: tracking-dayplan
jobs._what: tomorrow lined up the evening before (ruling 6): at tracking.json -> dayplan.plan_at, once a day, ONE plain message to the shared space when tomorrow has 3+ timed items (events, calls, deadlines, reminders, chases due back), owner's line only on days she has items; otherwise silence. Zero LLM

jobs.name: builds-requeue
jobs._what: puts builds back in the queue whose failure was not the build's: a 'protected core' hit on a file the test run regenerates (meta.json false positives, 2026-10-17/18), or a session-limit error once the reset time named in it has passed (the owner 2026-10-18: 'Build it another way', no builder.py edit). Zero-LLM; merge-saves builds.json so an owner's tap is never clobbered.

jobs.name: triage-drain
jobs._what: files the couple-page notes triage_next.py queued when an inbound text/email carried a contact, a finished questionnaire or a lost lead (wiki writes lint + commit, too slow for the sensor's own pass). Zero-LLM. Added 2026-10-18.

jobs.name: graduation
jobs._what: WP6: offer 'Make it automatic?' for an action class approved unchanged enough times (tracking.json -> graduation); demote a granted kind on its first failed outcome

jobs.name: core-sync
jobs._what: every commit here flows on to the sage-core checkout (assistant/core_sync.json core_root), organization-free: prose and comments scrubbed, a working line about this business holds the file + files a build request; zero LLM (2026-10-28)
